title: Loading coons_cube.dsl and test_bridge.dsl fails with 'Cannot load from int array because this.halfEdgeEdge is null'
description:
Found 2026-10-03 by two agents independently: selecting repo graphs coons_cube.dsl and test_bridge.dsl from the model menu (mesh-viewer and the ring-tool editing scene) fails with NullPointerException 'Cannot load from int array because this.halfEdgeEdge is null'. Probably one bug: some node output reaches a consumer before its half-edge connectivity is built (a lazily built or never-built halfEdgeEdge array). Find which node and fix it at the root, then check every repo graph in the model menu loads.

Root cause: commit 2c3da231 ('small refactor', 2026-05-10) deleted ArrayMesh.ensureTopology() and every call to it, leaving the topologyReady flag behind. Since then no ArrayMesh ever builds its twin/edge/adjacency arrays, so faceEdgeAt/halfEdgeEdge/halfEdgeTwin/isBoundary*/vertex* throw NPE and edgeCount() silently returns 0. The cube node (and the OBJ/OFF/PLY/glTF loaders, subdivide, extrude, transform, ...) produce ArrayMesh; coons_patch (CoonsPatchNode:138) and inset_faces (InsetFacesNode:379) are the first consumers to ask for edges. Stack: NullPointerException: Cannot load from int array because this.halfEdgeEdge is null at ArrayMesh.faceEdgeAt(ArrayMesh.java:605) at CoonsPatchNode.evaluate(CoonsPatchNode.java:138) / InsetFacesNode.insetFacesQuadWithSharedEdgeMerge(InsetFacesNode.java:379) at NodeGraphRuntime.executeGraphResult(NodeGraphRuntime.java:486).

Rework 2026-10-03 (user review): no ensureTopology() call in every accessor, and no wasted builds. (1) ArrayMesh's topology arrays move into one immutable holder (a private static nested class built from faceIndices, vertsPerFace and the vertex count) created on first use through a single private accessor; every topology accessor reads through it, so laziness lives in one place and meshes nobody asks for edges pay nothing. (2) Position-only changes share the topology: an ArrayMesh made from another with the same faces and new positions (for example ArrayMesh.withPositions) reuses the source's holder, built or not, and transform_geometry (TransformGeometryNode, the uniform-valence path that builds a new ArrayMesh) uses it. Measured on crawfish_union.dsl, where two 900k-face scan loads and the transform each paid about 0.45 s under eager construction.
definition-of-done:
1. coons_cube.dsl and test_bridge.dsl load in mesh-viewer. 2. The root cause is named on the ticket. 3. A sweep over every repo .dsl (list the results) shows which load and which fail and why.

6. ArrayMesh has one lazy topology holder and no per-accessor guard; withPositions shares it; transform_geometry uses it. 7. Sweep: same pass/fail as before, crawfish_repaired and crawfish_union at or below the lazy-era times (1.84 s, 7.83 s).
testing-plan: 1. Unit or integration test that executes both graphs headless. 2. Script that loads every repo graph and reports pass or fail.
changes-made: ArrayMesh: restored lazy ensureTopology() (built from QuadMeshTopologyHelper plus the outgoing-half-edge CSR) and called it from every accessor that reads topology arrays, including edgeHalfEdgeAtActiveIndex, edgeLength and edgeMidpoint added after the refactor. One file of shared mesh code; no consumer changed.

Test: unit.mesh.GraphTopologyLoadTest executes coons_cube.dsl and test_bridge.dsl headless through NodeGraphRuntime.executeGraphToMesh (port geometry, as the viewer) and checks every half-edge has an edge; plus a two-quad ArrayMesh strip checks edgeCount 7, shared middle edge, boundary flags. Fails on master with the ticket's NPE, passes with the fix.

Sweep (ixdar-cli model dsl/<file> against a running mesh-viewer, timeout 10 s per graph, failure read from the scene log): 34 of 37 load. PASS: birail_loft_ribbon, coons_cube, crawfish_repaired (1.8s), crawfish_union (7.8s), cube_boolean_textured, curve_sweep_tube, dungeon_2d, dungeon_3d, hand, hand_v10_dualradial, neck_armor, organic_test, petal, quad_cylinder_test, skull, test_bridge, test_finger, test_function, tool_quilt, varying_tube_test, voyage_skull, and all 14 fixtures/ (closing_loop_collapse, fan_collapse, fertility_ring_pick 2.3s, fertility_rings, loop_collapse, merged_cell_slot, pinched_cover, plane_layout, scaled_torus, sliver_pinch, stacked_zero_row_torus, torus_layout, torus_loop_through_points, twin_cell). No timeouts. FAIL (separate causes, not fixed here): fertility_quad_layout (load_mesh path 'ixdar-app/test/resources/quadlayout/figure_8/fertility_in_tri.off' is relative to the repo root but the viewer's cwd is ixdar-app; the file exists); hand_v11_bridged (adaptive_bridge_loops: no boundary loop found for tag 'th_base'; on master it failed earlier at 'ix_base' because the empty ArrayMesh topology hid a loop, so the fix moved it one bridge further); hand_v12_posed (adaptive_bridge_loops: no boundary loop found for tag 'rg_base'; on master: 'Non-manifold or duplicate face edge between 13 and 1').

Verification: mvn -q compile clean (checkstyle included); mvn test 367 run, 0 failures; launch entry 'MESH-55: mesh-viewer' (ixdar.model=dsl/test_bridge.dsl) loads verts=85 faces=89, screenshot tmp/mesh-55-test-bridge.png; coons_cube verts=294 faces=216, screenshot tmp/mesh-55-coons-cube.png.

2026-10-03 (coordinator, user review): topology is now built once in the ArrayMesh constructor (face indices are final) instead of lazily behind an ensureTopology() call in every accessor; the topology fields are final and the flag is gone. mvn test 367/0. Sweep unchanged (34 pass, same 3 unrelated failures); single-run load times: crawfish_repaired 1.84 -> 2.34 s, crawfish_union 7.83 -> 9.10 s, everything else within noise.

2026-10-03 rework (user review): ArrayMesh's twin/edge/adjacency arrays live in one private static immutable holder (ArrayMesh.Topology, built from faceIndices, vertsPerFace and the vertex count via QuadMeshTopologyHelper plus the outgoing-half-edge CSR). The mesh keeps one final AtomicReference<Topology>; the single private topology() accessor fills it on first use (compareAndExchange, a racing duplicate build loses) and every topology accessor reads through it; no flag, no per-accessor guard, no eager build. ArrayMesh.withPositions(positions, normals) makes a mesh over the same face buffer that shares the same AtomicReference, built or not, so the first edge query on either mesh builds once for both. getEdgeIndices and its cachedEdgeIndices field were deleted: topology-derived, but nothing called them. withPositions users: TransformGeometryNode uniform-valence path when the input is an ArrayMesh (dense ids, faces identical; a HalfEdgeMesh input still remaps and builds normally); MeshVertexOffset (SetPositionNode, and the zero-offset copies in MeshDeleteEdges, MeshDeleteVertices, MeshMergeByDistance); the identity copies in ArrayMeshEngine (solidify t=0, deleteVertices/deleteEdges with nothing to delete, mergeByDistance distance<=0, join with an empty side, loopCut cuts<=0, splitEdges with nothing to split); the no-op returns of ExtrudeMeshNode (both modes) and InsetFacesNode. CurveDeformNode produces a HalfEdgeMesh and is untouched.

Verification: mvn -q compile clean; mvn test 372 run, 0 failures, including GraphTopologyLoadTest's new withPositionsSharesTopologyAndEdgeIds (derived mesh builds nothing until asked, then one holder serves both, identical edge ids and twins) and meshNeverAskedForEdgesNeverBuildsThem (normals, compileSurfaceData and bounds leave the holder empty; the first faceEdgeAt fills it). tmp/sweep.sh run three times: 35 pass, 3 fail (fertility_quad_layout, hand_v11_bridged, hand_v12_posed, same causes), identical to the lazy and eager sweeps. crawfish_repaired 1.84/1.79/1.90 s (median 1.84; lazy 1.84, eager 2.34); crawfish_union 8.31/7.73/7.45 s (median 7.73; lazy 7.83, eager 9.10). ixd wt done passed (launch entry MESH-55: mesh-viewer, screenshot tmp/mesh-55-launch.png).
